podcast.title: Co-Host of Architects of Art Podcast
podcast.body: Taj Khrishlow is a co-host of the new podcast "Art Katex, the Architects of Art," which explores the creative journeys and processes of music video directors. "We have Taj Khrishlow and Director X. And we want to give you a bit of an introduction to what this new podcast is all about."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Founding Fella Production Company
podcast.body: Taj Khrishlow, along with Director X, founded the production company Fella, which achieved success with the music video for "Topstar" by DJ Khaled, Drake, and Justin Bieber. "We broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled, Drake and Bieber called Topstar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pioneering Canadian Directors
podcast.body: Taj Khrishlow is one of two individuals from Brampton, Ontario, who became internationally recognized for creating art through music videos. "And there were two kids from Brampton, Ontario that went out to make art that broke out to the world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
